title: Great Tapas & Wine Tour
text: This was a great wine and Tapas tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable and fun. The tapas was great, a lot of food, more than I would have expected but really good.
author: Kristina_P

title: Excellent evening and value
text: Our guide, Calie was excellent and a good leader. She selected great restaurants and wines. The tapas were excellent and the wines were from various locations around Spain. We will use her again next time we visit. We got full pours and enough food for dinner.
author: Derryan_M

title: The best ever!
text: Probably the best food tour we have ever taken!  Javier was incredible; the food excellent and the wines paired perfectly!  Wish we could rate it higher than a 5!
author: Robert_R

title: Javier and Claire curated...
text: Javier and Claire curated 3 great experiences with wonderful wines. The tapas choices were carefully paired with different varietals. All very well done. The conversation and company was terrific.
author: Sylvia_H

title: Wine Knowledge & Hidden Gems
text:
Our tour guide Kailie was phenomenal. She had extensive knowledge of wines not only from Spain, but from other regions of the globe. Her ability to cross reference helped us understand the world of wines better. 

Additionally, we were exposed to a lesser known area of Barcelona, full of hidden gem wine bars and tapas restaurants. 

We 1,000% recommend this tour!
author: Diana_P

title: 10/10 Experience!
text: What a beautiful experience in an incredible city. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and was so kind and polite. She was super friendly, relatable, and by the end, felt like another friend in the group. I cannot recommend this experience enough.
author: Nick_D

title: Tasty eats and vino with Javier
text: Javier is knowledgeable, articulate and had a great sense of humor. You can always judge a person by how they are greeted by people and everywhere we went people genuinely loved seeing him. Wines were exciting to try also.  Highly recommend him. !!!!
author: Corina_G

title: Food and wine tour with sommelier
text: It was such an enjoyable experience we had with our sommelier Kaylee. She was so sweet and very knowledgeable about our wine and food pairing and history of Barcelona and vineyard in the area. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who has a love for food and wine. Thank you so much for an amazing evening.
author: hermanmonique

title: Fantastic Food and Wines
text: Guide was fabulous.  It wound up being only 4 of us and the places she chose were outstanding.  The food and wince choices were top notch and was definitely the best tour we took in Barcelona.  I would recommend doing this tour the first night or 2 in Barcelona as we would have wanted to go back to some of the restaurants for dinner.  Only feedback I have is to change the meeting point directions to 1 Rda de Sant Paul vice 11.  Once I GPS “Stay Together Barcelona Apartments”, I had no trouble finding her.
author: loweam

title: Experience Barcelona like a native!
text: Wonderful evening sampling and learning about local wines and food at hidden tapas bars in Barcelona that are off the beaten path. Javier is extremely knowledgeable and entertaining. A must next time you visit.
author: mnkush57
